title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available in Devin Desktop and CLI. On FrontierCode 2.0, Carbon scores 40.0%...
text: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available in Devin Desktop and CLI. On FrontierCode 2.0, Carbon scores 40.0% – a substantial step up from Gemini 4 Argon’s 26.3% – making it the best performing Google model on the benchmark. 💬34🔄38❤️558👀47589📊96 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
